functions.name: ping
functions.description: No-op. Exists only so background.js can force this Experiment's privileged parent script to load at startup (in case Thunderbird loads Experiment APIs lazily on first access rather than eagerly) without triggering any actual cleanup side effects.

functions.name: cleanup
functions.description: Finds certificates known to NSS under more than one issuer+serial-matching record where at least one of those records lives on the OS Client Certs token, and deletes the other (stale, keyless) records. Returns the list of records deleted.
